## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The containment check in `preview` needs fixing before merge. It compares paths as text without resolving them, so a relative path containing `..` gets past the check and the function reads files outside the home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview` to `app/paths.py`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under a home directory, and `settings_file`, which returns `<home>/settings.toml`. It adds tests for both functions and a text file, `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` passes the check and reads a file outside home, because `Path.is_relative_to` compares path parts as text and `home/../secret.txt` begins with `home`'s parts. Symlinks under home that point outside it also pass, because nothing calls `resolve()`. The only outside-path case the test checks, at `tests/test_paths.py:20`, uses an absolute path. — A caller passing user-supplied relative paths lets anyone read arbitrary files the process can access. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, and add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
